task_instruction: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.

steps.subgoal: assemble the stable lower tower base
steps.vla_instruction: build the lower base with two upright wooden blocks supporting one wooden board
steps.expected_outcome: one horizontal wooden board is stably supported by two upright wooden blocks at the lower level

steps.subgoal: assemble the supported middle tower level
steps.vla_instruction: build the middle level with two upright wooden blocks supporting a second wooden board on the base
steps.expected_outcome: a second horizontal wooden board is stably supported above the lower board by two upright wooden blocks
constraints: do not disturb the completed lower base
keep the middle board centered over its supports

steps.subgoal: complete and align the top tower structure
steps.vla_instruction: complete the top using the remaining rectangular wooden piece and top cube without disturbing lower levels
steps.expected_outcome: the remaining rectangular wooden piece and top cube are centered and stacked above the middle board, completing the tower
constraints: preserve the completed base and middle levels
finish with a stable aligned top
